crossRefs.note: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

people.name: Eder
people.line: Levite descendant of Merari during David's reign

people.name: Jerimoth
people.line: A Levite, son of Mushi, from the Merari clan.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Mushi, grandson of Merari.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.

translations.web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
translations.bsb: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites, according to their families.
translations.kjv: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
translations.asv: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers' houses.
